text: Kaheti Lords are nerubian spiderlords located in the Pulsing Pit in Nerub-ar Palace.
Kaheti Sentries are nerubians located in the Grand Rampart in Nerub-ar Palace.
Kaheti Skirmishers are nerubians located in the Grand Rampart in Nerub-ar Palace.
The Kaldorei Fleet (or the Night Elf Fleet) is the maritime military force of the Darnassian Army. It is part of the Alliance navy and includes at least a few dozen ships.

Kafa'goot "Deposits" are piles of goat droppings located on Kota Peak in Kun-Lai Summit. Cousin Gootfur wants them marked with small flags so he can more easily find them and collect the kafa beans inside once the peak is safe for harvesting again.

Kafaccinos are obtained by trading to Cousin Shortkaf in Founder's Point or Razorwind Shores. Shortkaf will give one Kafaccino for every five Kafa'kota Berries. This item can be offered to Sleepy Residents around the neighborhood to perk them up.

Kafa Creamer is housing decor that can be purchased for 5 Community Coupons from Brother Dovetail, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Friend of the Grummles endeavor. This item becomes purchasable after the neighborhood has reached the third milestone on the Endeavor Progress bar.
Kalimdor Sand Dye was a housing dye used to color certain housing decor. It could be crafted by alchemists or scribes via Dye Crafting with 1 Brown Dye Pigment.
Kale'thas Sunsalad is a food item sold by the following vendors for in stacks of 5:
Kalis is a banshee of the Derelict Duo council encounter in the Windrunner Spire dungeon. She is fanatically loyal to Sylvanas Windrunner.
Kal'rak the Drunk is an orc who was planned to appear as part of a vignette in Gorgrond.
Kahul the Sunseer is an ally card from the War of the Ancients set.
Kalika is a forest troll tailoring trainer located in the Witherbark Bluffs in Zul'Aman.

]] Kaja'mite elementals (also known as kaja'mentals) are a type of elementals found at the Kaja'Coast in Zuldazar. They are a conglomerate of earth elementals and kaja'mite crystals. In combat, they use their crystalline hands to fist and slice their enemies. The Massive Kaja'mental's worldsoul memory reveals that the goblins first encountered them upon discovering kaja'mite centuries ago. When the goblin cartels began their operations, the kaja'mentals grew hostile and attacked the workers. The adventurers were eventually tasked to put them down and recover the raw materials.
Kalaya is a jungle troll located on Darkspear Isle in the Echo Isles during the Darkspear Dash.

Kasthrik is a sethrak who appears in Fungal Folly. After the Horde aided the Devoted in Vol'dun she traveled to Orgrimmar. She then ventured to the Dragon Isles and joined the Dragonscale Expedition. She later ventured to the Isle of Dorn as well with the rest of the expedition. She intends to one day return home to Vol'dun with stories of what she's seen.

Karazhan Graduate is a title awarded upon using Bronze Celebration Titles: Karazhan Graduate. The title appears before your character's name: :Karazhan Graduate

Karazhan Crypts is a level 60 dungeon unique to , situated under the tower of Karazhan. Entering the dungeon originally required the attunement quest Testing Our Hypothesis, which starts with For Gold and Glory! at Light's Hope Chapel. Much like Demon Fall Canyon was built out of the area of the same name, this is an expansion of what would later be known as the Forgotten Crypt.
Kas'dru is an ascended nerubian and is one of the minions that can spawn from Zekvir's Influence, effectively replacing a group of mobs in a delve. They are accompanied by and riding Venombite.

Karazhan Curios drop randomly from mobs and bosses in the Karazhan Crypts after completing Testing Our Hypothesis. They can be turned in to Harrison Jones for a Supply Bag (Karazhan Crypts).

__NOTOC__ Kasiea, appearing as a Mysterious Corpse, is a void elf found dead near the bridge across the Elrendar River by Tranquillien in Eversong Woods. Kasiea was a student of Magister Umbric, who described her as bright and dedicated to her research. When the ren'dorei arrived in Eversong Woods, she disappeared soon after. Umbric assumed that she left because of how they were isolated and that she would go back to Telogrus Rift. Kasiea did not leave, however, she continued her research on the Void, which brought her to Tranquillien, where she uncovered secrets that got her killed. Kazzara, the Hellforged is a boss in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.

Keeper Meridon is a keeper of the grove found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. he came to say farewell to Gracus alongside other friends. After his passing, he remained by the burial site with Admiral Peppers and other ducks.

Keeper Adranas is a keeper of the grove found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. In the past, he accompanied his great friend, Gracus, to fight against the Emerald Nightmare on an islet that the kid Rani dreamed herself into. He invited the adventurer to rest in the Dream. After they woke up, he was called by the adventurer to come to say farewell to Gracus. After defeating the memory of the past, Gracus passed, and Adranas remained to tend to his burial site. He was eager to meet his new friend who would be born from Gracus.

Kaz'arin is a jungle troll found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. In the past, he accompanied his friend, Gracus, to fight against the Emerald Nightmare on an islet that the kid Rani dreamed herself into. Kaz'arin was called by the adventurer to come to say farewell to the dying Gracus and attended his passing.

Kauriq the Gleamfisher is a tuskarr spirit located in Kauriq Gleamlet in the Azure Span. She is the founder of the Kauriq tribe and the namesake of the Gleamlet.
The Kauriq Gleamlet is a large fishing camp belonging to the Kauriq tribe of tuskarr living in the Azure Span.

Kee Kee is a young hozen located on the Wandering Isle. He befriended Jia. When the time for the pandaren Spirit Festival came, Jia asked the Fe-Feng hozen to take the fireworks at Morning Breeze Village so that she could play with Kee Kee, and Chieftain Huk Huk obliged. When Aysa Cloudsinger, Ji Firepaw, and a pandaren champion were looking for the missing fireworks, they found clues of the hozen's involvement and entered the village. After confronting Huk Huh, the chieftain took the pandaren visitors to the western part of the village, where Kee Kee and Jia were playing, with the fireworks being set next to them. Kel'Thuzad's Leggings may refer to: *Kel'Thuzad's Leggings of Conquest *Kel'Thuzad's Leggings of Triumph *Kel'Thuzad's Leggings of Triumph (heroic) (heroic)

Kevo ya Siti is the loa of cunning. He appears as a masked mistlurker and is one of the main loa of the Darkspear tribe of trolls, alongside whom he lives on the Echo Isles. He is a swift hunter who uses shadow and illusion.
Kevo ya Siti's Mask of Cunning is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Heritage of the Darkspear.
The Kevo ya Siti Offering is placed upon the Altar of the Loa in Darkspear Hold on the Echo Isles during the Heritage of the Darkspear.

Before Dalaran's destruction, Kereke was a prisoner of the Violet Hold alongside Rotfist and Zovex, who share the spawn location. When engaged in combat, the Sunreaver Battlemage and Kirin Tor Conjuror holding him die.
Kereke's Flourishing Sabre drops from Kereke at the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Keyrra Flamestonge is an Arathi located in Shadowgrove Vineyards in Hallowfall.
Kelpmire is a fungal giant located at the Waterworks in the Ringing Deeps.
Keila Warhavuk is an Arathi child riding Dawnflame in Lorel's Crossing in Hallowfall.

Kelther Hearthen is a dead Arathi found at Cliffside Beason in Hallowfall. He was ritualistically sacrificed. After being found by an adventurer, Faerin Lothar commented that General Steelstrike will make sure someone gets Kelther's body.

The key opens doors inside the :Ratts' Revenge scenario as part of the secret to obtain the Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle.

Kernel Sprites are small sprites found in groups of 5 at the Imperial Granary in the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ Kelmortos is a Mawsworn construct located in the Grand Design of the Sepulcher of the First Ones. It guards the door into the Heart of Eternity.
Kelum'ko's Generous Aromatic Gift is a quest "reward" from Unlikely Friends. If the duration runs out, so will the blessing and its high sellprice.

Kel'vujo is a forest troll located in Bitterbark in Zul'Aman. In order to prove himself as an Amani warrior, Kel'vujo was tasked with collecting trophies from the gnarldin. However, he thought he could outsmart the trial by asking Zul'jarra's hash'ura to collect them for him. He also requested they collect tablets from Amani hunters that had fallen (or feigned death) to the gnarldin. For his final trophy, Kel'vujo wanted to take one from the leader of the Gnarldin in the area, Tusk Taker, and sent the hash'ura to fight them. After defeating the Gnarldin, Kel'vujo claimed all the trophies in their lair. With his trial complete, Kel'vujo planned to meet with Huntmaster Jinki and present his sp

Key of Fused Darkness is looted on a table in a spire in Stormarion Citadel in the Voidstorm. To be able to loot the key, you must first drink the Potion of Diassociation. The key opens the Void-Shielded Tomb treasure.
Key to the Arcantina is provided by Kurdran Wildhammer for The Arcantina.
Keg of Thunderbrew is a quest reward from the repeatable quest Thunderbrew (quest), an exchange of five Hops for one Keg.
Kept You Waiting Huh? is a raid achievement earned by defeating the Vashnik the Malignant after killing the Solidified Snake Venom in Ula'tek Temple on Normal difficulty or higher.
Kelp Nibblers are sea slugs found at the Restless Wetlands on the Waking Shores.
Kelvin is a pango located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Kelena Ashford is an ally card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Kelsa Wildfire is an ally card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.

Kickin' With the Wick is awarded to players who defeat the Headless Horseman encounter during Hallow's End while debuffed by all four wickermen before starting the encounter. The central (larger) wickerman can apply all four at once. The debuffs are individual, so each player attempting the encounter must interact with the wickermen. The debuffs make the encounter marginally harder, generally tasking players with additional movement and killing extra adds.
Khaz Algar Safari is a pet battle achievement earned by catching all of the battle pets on Khaz Algar. It rewards the battle pet Waxwick.
Khole is an earthen located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal.
Khaz Algar Completionist: Bronze is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing all races in Khaz Algar.
Khaz Algar Completionist: Gold is an expansion feature achievement earned by obtaining gold in all races in Khaz Algar. It rewards the title Khaz Algar Racer.
Khaz Algar Completionist: Silver is an expansion feature achievement earned by obtaining silver in all races in Khaz Algar.
Khaz Algar Glyph Hunter is an exploration meta-achievement earned by finding all of the Skyriding Glyphs in the four base zones of Khaz Algar.

Khonsu is a horusath, and the true form of the Wandering Swordsman. He reveals himself and battles players after challenging them in . Though he allows opponents to choose Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty for the fight, he will only grant rewards on Medium or Hard. Clearing the encounter on Hard 17 times in a row without dying grants the buff, unlocking a cosmetic sunglass effect that can be toggled by performing a "/flex" emote.
Khaz Algar Diplomat is a reputation achievement earned by reaching max renown with each of the reputations listed below. This is one of the criteria of All That Khaz.
Khaz Algar Explorer is an exploration achievement earned by exploring the regions of the Khaz Algar.
Khaz Algar Lore Hunter is an exploration achievement earned by discovering the following lore objects across Khaz Algar.

The Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle teaches Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle, a deathcycle mount. It is acquired by solving a lengthy series of Secrets of Azeroth puzzles, using the standard tools for those: the toys Torch of Pyrreth, Tricked-Out Thinking Cap, and Idol of Ohn'ahra, along with a new tool, the Starry-Eyed Goggles. While riding Incognitro, the spell Override Sequence is added to the spellbook. Currently-known inputs yield nothing more than easter eggs, but the spell may be used to unlock additional functionality for the mount or interact with new secrets in the future. Khadin's Cave is an area located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. It is the home of Khadin.
Khuri's Fishing Spot is an area located in the Azure Span. It is where Khuri spends most of his time.

Khaz Algar proficiency is the eleventh stage of a profession learned at the appropriate profession trainer when a character has reached at least level 70. It unlocks the use and development of profession related skills in Khaz Algar related content. Not counting racial or other bonuses, it allows skill ups to a maximum of 100 points.
